ayahs.textArabic: حٰمۤ  ۚ
ayahs.textEnglish: Ha. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER this divine writ, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ فِيْ لَيْلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā anzalnāhu fī lailatim mubārakatin innā kunnā munżirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, from on high have We bestowed it on a blessed night: for, verily, We have always been warning [man].

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ حَكِيْمٍۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: On that [night] was made clear, in wisdom, the distinction between all things [good and evil]

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْرًا مِّنْ عِنْدِنَاۗ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِيْنَۖ
ayahs.textEnglish: at a behest from Ourselves: for, verily, We have always been sending [Our messages of guidance]

ayahs.textArabic: رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ ۗاِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: in pur­suance of thy Sustainer’s grace [unto man]. Verily, He alone is all-hearing, all-knowing,

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۘ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā, in kuntum mūqinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them - if you could but grasp it with inner certainty!

ayahs.textArabic: لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيٖ وَيُمِيْتُ ۗرَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ اٰبَاۤىِٕكُمُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥyī wa yumīt(u), rabbukum wa rabbu ābā'ikumul-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: There is no deity save Him: He grants life and deals death: He is your Sustainer as well as the Sustainer of your forebears of old.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ يَّلْعَبُوْنَ
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but they [who lack inner certainty] are but Dying with their doubts.

ayahs.textArabic: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى السَّمَاۤءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textEnglish: WAIT, THEN, for the Day when the skies shall bring forth a pall of smoke which will make obvious [the approach of the Last Hour],

ayahs.textArabic: يَغْشَى النَّاسَۗ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textEnglish: enveloping all mankind, [and causing the sinners to exclaim:] “Grievous is this suffering!

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textEnglish: O our Sustainer, relieve us of suffering, for, verily, we [now] believe [in Thee]!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَنّٰى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرٰى وَقَدْ جَاۤءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّبِيْنٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Annā lahumuż-żikrā wa qad jā'ahum rasūlum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] how shall this remembrance avail them [at the Last Hour], seeing that an apostle had pre­viously come unto them, clearly expounding the truth,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوْا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُوْنٌۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma tawallau ‘anhu wa qālū mu‘allamum majnūn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereupon they turned their backs on him and said, “Taught [by others] is he, a madman”?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الْعَذَابِ قَلِيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ عَاۤىِٕدُوْنَۘ
ayahs.textEnglish: [Still,] behold, We shall postpone this suffer­ing for a little while, although you are bound to revert [to your evil ways: but]

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرٰىۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma nabṭisyul baṭsyatal kubrā, innā muntaqimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: on the Day when We shall seize [all sinners] with a most mighty onslaught, We shall, verily, inflict Our retribution [on you as well]!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاۤءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ كَرِيْمٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad fatannā qablahum qauma fir‘auna wa jā'ahum rasūlun karīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, [long] before their time did We try Pharaoh’s people [in the same way]: for there came unto them a noble apostle, [who said:]

ayahs.textArabic: اَنْ اَدُّوْٓا اِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِ ۗاِنِّيْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِيْنٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: An addū ilayya ‘ibādallāh(i), innī lakum rasūlun amīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Give in unto me, O God’s bondmen! Verily, I am an apostle [sent] unto you, worthy of trust!

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنْ لَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۚاِنِّيْٓ اٰتِيْكُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa al lā ta‘lū ‘alallāh(i), innī ātīkum bisulṭānim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And exalt not yourselves against God: for, verily, I come unto you with a manifest authority [from Him];

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنِّيْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ اَنْ تَرْجُمُوْنِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innī ‘użtu birabbī wa rabbikum an tarjumūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, behold, it is with my Sustainer - and your Sustainer - that I seek refuge against all your endeavours to revile me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوْا لِيْ فَاعْتَزِلُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa il lam tu'minū lī fa‘tazilūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And if you do not believe me, [at least] stand away from me!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗٓ اَنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa da‘ā rabbahū anna hā'ulā'i qaumum mujrimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But then, [when they beset him with their enmity,] he called out to his Sustainer, “These are [indeed] people lost in sin!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْ لَيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa asri bi‘ibādī lailan innakum muttaba‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [God said]: “Go thou forth with My servants by night, for you will surely be pursued;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًاۗ اِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.textEnglish: and leave the sea becalmed [between thee and Pharaoh’s men]: for, verily, they are a host destined to be drowned!”

ayahs.textArabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوْا مِنْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: [And so they perished: and] how many gardens did they leave behind, and water-runnels,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّزُرُوْعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيْمٍۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: and fields of grain, and noble dwellings,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْا فِيْهَا فٰكِهِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: and [all that] life of ease in which they used to delight!

ayahs.textArabic: كَذٰلِكَ ۗوَاَوْرَثْنٰهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus it was. And [then] We made another people heirs [to what they had left],

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاۤءُ وَالْاَرْضُۗ وَمَا كَانُوْا مُنْظَرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Famā bakat ‘alaihimus-samā'u wal-arḍ(u), wa mā kānū munẓarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and neither sky nor earth shed tears over them, nor were they allowed a respite.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِيْنِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad najjainā banī isrā'īla minal-‘ażābil-muhīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, indeed, We delivered the children of Israel from the shameful suffering

ayahs.textArabic: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ ۗاِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
ayahs.textEnglish: [inflicted on them] by Pharaoh, seeing that he was truly outstand­ing among those who waste their own selves;

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنٰهُمْ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textEnglish: and indeed, We chose them knowingly above all other people,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الْاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيْهِ بَلٰۤـؤٌا مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ātaināhum minal-āyāti mā fīhi balā'um mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and gave them such signs [of Our grace] as would clearly presage a test.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ لَيَقُوْلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: [Now,] behold, these [people] say indeed:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ هِيَ اِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْاُوْلٰى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: In hiya illā mautatunal-ūlā wa mā naḥnu bimunsyarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “That [which is ahead of us] is but our first [and only] death, and we shall not be raised to life again.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأْتُوْا بِاٰبَاۤىِٕنَآ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textEnglish: So then, bring forth our forefathers [as witnesses], if what you claim is true!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَهُمْ خَيْرٌ اَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۙ وَّالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْۗ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ahum khairun am qaumu tubba‘(in), wal-lażīna min qablihim, ahlaknāhum innahum kānū mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are they, then, better than the people of Tubba and those before them, whom We destroyed because they were truly lost in [the same] sin?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā lā‘ibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For [thus it is:] We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in mere idle play:

ayahs.textArabic: مَا خَلَقْنٰهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqqi wa lākinna akṡarahum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: none of this have We created without [an inner] truth: but most of them under­stand it not.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيْقَاتُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false] is the term appointed for all of them:

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ مَوْلًى عَنْ مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma lā yugnī maulan ‘am maulan syai'aw wa lā hum yunṣarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Day when no friend shall be of the least avail to his friend, and when none shall be succoured

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُ ۗاِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.textEnglish: save those upon whom God will have bestowed His grace and mercy: for, verily, He alone is almighty, a dispenser of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, [in the life to come] the tree of deadly fruit

ayahs.textArabic: طَعَامُ الْاَثِيْمِ ۛ
ayahs.textEnglish: will be the food of the sinful:

ayahs.textArabic: كَالْمُهْلِ ۛ يَغْلِيْ فِى الْبُطُوْنِۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: like molten lead will it boil in the belly,

ayahs.textArabic: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيْمِ ۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: like the boiling of burning despair.

ayahs.textArabic: خُذُوْهُ فَاعْتِلُوْهُ اِلٰى سَوَاۤءِ الْجَحِيْمِۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: [And the word will be spoken:] “Seize him, [O you forces of hell,] and drag him into the midst of the blazing fire:

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهٖ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيْمِۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: then pour over his head the anguish of burning despair!

ayahs.textArabic: ذُقْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْكَرِيْمُ
ayahs.textEnglish: Taste it - thou who [on earth] hast considered thyself so mighty, so noble!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżā mā kuntum bihī tamtarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: This is the very thing which you [deniers of the truth] were wont to call in question!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ مَقَامٍ اَمِيْنٍۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: [As against this -] verily, the God-conscious will find themselves in a state secure,

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: amid gardens and springs,

ayahs.textArabic: يَّلْبَسُوْنَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yalbasūna min sundusiw wa istabraqim mutaqābilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: wearing [garments] of silk and brocade, facing one another [in love].

ayahs.textArabic: كَذٰلِكَۗ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus shall it be. And We shall pair them with companions pure, most beautiful of eye.

ayahs.textArabic: يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: In that [paradise] they shall [rightfully] claim all the fruits [of their past deeds], resting in security;

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا الْمَوْتَ اِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْاُوْلٰىۚ وَوَقٰىهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yażūqūna fīhal-mauta illal-mautatal-ūlā, wa waqāhum ‘ażābal-jaḥīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and neither shall they taste death there after having passed through their erstwhile death. Thus will He have preserved them from all suffer­ing through the blazing fire-

ayahs.textArabic: فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكَۚ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ
ayahs.textEnglish: an act of thy Sustainer’s favour: and that, that will be the triumph supreme!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: THUS, THEN, [O Prophet,] have We made this [divine writ] easy to understand, in thine own [human] tongue, so that men might take it to heart.

ayahs.textArabic: فَارْتَقِبْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّرْتَقِبُوْنَ ࣖࣖ
ayahs.textEnglish: So wait thou [for what the future will bring]: behold, they, too, are waiting.
